channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Pakistan army ‘cautiously optimistic’ about US-Iran mediation efforts
item.description: Pakistan's military spokesman warns of 'powerful spoilers and detractors' who still believe the conflict serves them.

item.title: Oman rescues 25 from burning oil tanker in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Incident comes as Iran says three oil tankers were halted while attempting to use 'unauthorised routes' to cross Hormuz.

item.title: ‘Need a Plan B’: Yemenis in Aden prepare for another war as missiles fall
item.description: As Houthi missiles strike Aden, residents stockpile food and prepare escape plans, fearing a return to all-out war.

item.title: Senators briefed on Trump’s ‘insane’ plan to restart war on Iran
item.description: Senator Chris Murphy says he’s been briefed on Trump’s plan to restart the war on Iran.

item.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
item.description: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.
